layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 md:py-40 for major sections.

motion.hero: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load using Framer Motion (initial y: 100%, animate y: 0, overflow hidden on parent).
motion.scroll: Staggered scroll-in fade animations. 1 subtle parallax moment for large project galleries using useScroll and useTransform.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee strip with accent text looping seamlessly.

sections.name: Header/Navigation
sections.details: Sticky/Fixed top navigation, glassmorphism background (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/80`). Left: Logo/Name. Right: Anchor Links (Home, Work, About, Contact). DO NOT use fully transparent background.

sections.name: Hero
sections.details: Large kinetic typography. Heading 'Noyanika Dixit'. Subheadline 'Creative Strategist — Brand, Content & Conversion'. 60-word intro. Circular/soft-edged headshot image. Stat bar at the bottom: 4 columns separated by 1px borders. Big bold numbers, small uppercase labels (e.g., '170% CTR LIFT').

sections.name: Marquee
sections.details: Continuous scrolling text strip ('Brand, Content & Conversion') using react-fast-marquee. Very slow drift, elegant serif font, separated by bullet dots.

sections.name: Selected Work
sections.details: Numbered manifesto-style chapter heading ('01 / Selected Work'). 5 editorial project cards stacked vertically with generous padding between them. Each card: Large hero image (subtle parallax), Title (Playfair Display), one-line category tag (Deep Plum), body paragraph, 'Role' list (comma separated), highlighted 'Impact' line in Deep Plum with real numbers.

sections.name: About
sections.details: Numbered heading ('02 / About'). Split layout: Left column with a secondary image or whitespace, Right column with personal paragraph, education line ('NIFT, MFM'), and a 'Download Resume' solid button in Deep Plum (#4A0E4E).

sections.name: Contact
sections.details: Numbered heading ('03 / Contact'). Massive heading 'Let's Build Something'. Centered minimal text links for Email, Phone, LinkedIn.

visual_enhancers.images: Spotlight treatment, clipped frames (sharp or very slight radius, e.g., rounded-md). High-quality editorial crops.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E5E5 for dividers, stat bars, and structural separations.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Sharp rectangular or pill-shaped. Background #4A0E4E, text white, smooth hover states (darken background or slight scale).

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use TypeScript. Write purely in JavaScript (`.js` or `.jsx` depending on the build setup, but keep strictly to valid JS).
Add the Google Fonts import provided in the typography section to your main `index.css`.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling inside a useEffect at the root component level.
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive and informational elements for testing.
The hero section title MUST use Framer Motion for a line-by-line reveal animation.
Ensure 'Deep Plum' (#4A0E4E) is the ONLY accent color used (for tags, specific highlighted numbers, and buttons). Everything else should be monochrome/cream.
Do NOT center text globally. Use left-alignment for body and layout structure. Only center things when explicitly requested (like the contact links).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where needed, but never use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties like opacity, transform, background-color.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use placeholder AI assistant emojis for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NEVER use placeholder text for missing images/logos.
